summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of Lluna Blanca Blanes marketing site. All requested features working: page loads with no JS errors, all section headings render, hero CTAs (tel: & wa.me) correct, 4 service tabs switch correctly (6/6/5/6 cards), testimonial prev/next work and Google links point to correct placeid URLs, updated schedule 'Lunes – Viernes 9:00 – 13:00 · 16:30 – 19:30' plus Sábado/Domingo Cerrado renders in Contacto, embedded Google Maps iframe present, contact tel/WhatsApp buttons correct, FAQ accordion opens/closes and item 4 answer contains '9:00 a 13:00 y de 16:30 a 19:30', all 3 legal modals (aviso 2919 chars, privacidad 4017 chars, cookies 2442 chars) open with full text, floating WhatsApp appears on scroll on both desktop and mobile (390px) viewports and links to wa.me/34636604359. No console/page errors, only minor a11y warnings.

design_issues.screen: Legal dialogs (Aviso legal, Política de privacidad, Política de cookies)
issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description or aria-describedby — a11y warning in console. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to each dialog.

Console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position...' — a scroll container lacks position:relative/absolute/fixed. Cosmetic but should be resolved to avoid incorrect scroll offset calculations.

action_items: (Low priority) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to the three legal dialogs to remove Radix a11y warning.
